mission: Genentech pioneers biotechnology medicines for people with serious and life-threatening diseases.

featured.responsibilities: Contribute to GenAI application projects with a Genentech team; analyze data/prototypes, collaborate with scientists and engineers, and present progress in a structured internship setting.

mission: NYGC advances genomic research to improve human health through technology, collaboration, and discovery.

featured.position: Research / computational genomics role (select a live NYGC posting)
featured.responsibilities: Typical NYGC scientific roles involve running or analyzing genomics experiments, collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams, and documenting methods/results for internal and external partners.
featured.qualifications: Usually requires relevant BS/MS/PhD experience in genomics, computational biology, or a related field; programming or wet-lab skills depending on the specific posting. Choose an open requisition on the listings page.

mission: MSK is dedicated to ending cancer for life through patient care, research, and education.

featured.position: Research technician / specialist role in cancer biology (select a live MSK posting)
featured.responsibilities: Support laboratory research such as sample processing, assays, data recording, and coordination with PIs and core facilities on cancer-focused projects.
featured.qualifications: Often requires a bachelor’s (or higher) in a biological science and prior lab experience; some roles prefer molecular biology, animal work, or clinical research experience. Apply to a specific open MSK job ID.

mission: Addgene is a nonprofit that accelerates research by sharing plasmids and related research materials worldwide.

featured.position: Scientific / repository operations role (select a live Addgene posting)
featured.responsibilities: Help scientists deposit and request materials, maintain quality processes for the repository, and support documentation or customer-facing scientific questions.
featured.qualifications: Usually a biology background (BS+), attention to detail, and comfort with SOPs/databases; some roles emphasize molecular biology or scientist support experience.

mission: Janelia brings scientists and tool-builders together to solve fundamental problems in biology.

featured.position: Research specialist / postdoctoral scientific role (select a live Janelia posting)
featured.responsibilities: Carry out independent or collaborative research, develop methods/tools, and share results with Janelia lab groups in a highly interdisciplinary environment.
featured.qualifications: Typically a PhD or advanced research experience in neuroscience, imaging, computational biology, or related areas depending on the lab posting.

mission: HHMI supports discovery science for the benefit of humanity.

featured.position: Scientific or research-support role at HHMI (select a live posting)
featured.responsibilities: Contribute to research programs or scientific infrastructure supporting HHMI investigators and institute initiatives.
featured.qualifications: Varies by role; scientific positions usually require advanced training in a relevant discipline and evidence of research productivity or technical specialization.

mission: The Simons Foundation advances the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences.

featured.position: Science / research program role (select a live Simons posting)
featured.responsibilities: Support scientific programs, research initiatives, or foundation operations that fund and enable basic science.
featured.qualifications: Depends on the posting; research-adjacent roles often seek scientific training plus project, data, or program experience.
